findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a small leak in the front dump sink. The leak is being collected in a bucket and the water from the bucket is being discarded regularly. Ensure this leak is repaired prior to your next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Eliminate vents on back door.Replace cover electrical plate next to back door. Replace missing trim in dish area.Caulk to floor & wall. Seal outlet to wall. Clean & recaulk mop sink. Add self closure to restroom door.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
